column5: The configured executor validates one planner-promised FullSchema width, accepts only non-null signed-BIGINT configured keys, and stably orders materialized rows through the canonical order.rs comparator; test chunk sizing, session memory trackers, random data generation, and general executor fixtures remain open.

The bounded runtime establishes deterministic lexicographic key comparison and source-order ties before a later owner adds merge cursors; chunk iterators, heap merge state, spill sources, cancellation, and cross-partition ordering remain open.

Configured signed-BIGINT rows sort by planner-resolved offsets and independent ASC/DESC bits only after all input validates, so invalid width or datum kind cannot become equality; parallel workers, TopN admission, child execution, memory/disk quotas, interrupts, and lifecycle ownership remain open.

The canonical comparator is shared with the existing executor ORDER BY paths while this constrained consumer rejects non-Int keys explicitly; failpoints, random worker failures, cursor reload, spill state, panic recovery, and logging remain open.
